body: Lease lapses only for a holder whose nose is still behind the box edge (on its source lane); a holder in the box keeps it, because releasing lets a crossing kinematic car pass through its body (kinematic casts skip kinematic cars). Alternative rejected: lapse everywhere as the task text literally says.

Lease alone (reservation_timeout 5 s) on seed 1: 19 -> 4 cars stopped > 20 s (worst 53 s). Remaining jam: a granted head car at the stop line held by walkers pressed into its nose corners; the crosswalk centre line lies 0.01-2.95 m before every lane end (365 lanes), under the front of a waiting car.

Second root rule: per-lane stop line derived from the sidewalk crossing at the lane end (crossing s - crossing_clearance, data), used by the stop-line obstacle, the never-run-the-line clamp, request distance and spawn speed. Alternatives rejected: a constant setback (wrong on lanes whose crossing is inside the box), walkers yielding to cars (civilian domain rewrite).

Only the first car of a lane joins a junction queue (heads set from the occupancy). The original seed-1 deadlock was two followers granted behind ungranted heads whose connectors conflicted; followers in the FCFS order also blocked other approaches. With the rule, seed-1 worst stop 59 -> 32 s, seed 42 62 -> 39 s. Kept together with the lease (lease = safety net for any holder that cannot move). Alternative: lease alone (leaves follower head-of-line blocking).

Residual waits of 30-39 s after the three rules are junction saturation, not deadlock: the in-view junction passes ~11 cars/min, 18 of 22 grants from rest with 8.1 s mean hold (IDM a 0.73 from a standstill), vs 2-3.5 s holds for moving cars elsewhere. Data levers probed: max_cars 16 (no fix, 38 s), turn_speed 8 (no fix), no civilians (still 33 s), idm.acceleration 1.5 (seeds 1/7 clean, 2 at 34 s, 42 at 28 s). Not applied: GDD start value, owner decision.

Recommended gating the lease by contention (stale only while a conflicting waiter exists at the node) instead of forbidding a same-tick re-grant of an uncontested lapsed holder; alternative: code change that skips re-grant in the lapse tick.

Lease lapse is enforced in code only while a waiter for a conflicting connector exists at the node (waiters pruned before occupants, so contention is read from the current heads); the city gate counts a stale grant under the same condition, and a deterministic plus() fixture gates the lapse tick. Alternative rejected: keep lapsing uncontested holders and only relax the gate (the same-tick re-grant would stay an invisible churn).

No direct lane-head fixture gate added: with a=1.5 and the 40 s bound the heads-off flip stays RED on the city gate (seed 1 69.0 s). Alternative: a follower-queueing fixture, deferred as the orchestrator made it conditional on the flip going GREEN.
